matter.title: A shared workshop space
matter.description: A community group wants to open a shared workshop. Some members prioritise low fees; others want enough paid staff to make opening hours reliable. We do not yet know likely usage or operating costs. We want to understand the different priorities and possibilities before making a decision.

item.title: How should affordable access and reliable staffing be balanced?
item.body: Costs, usage and staffing needs remain unknown. We can record different priorities without choosing an arrangement.

item.title: Prioritise low fees and broad participation
item.body: My priority is keeping participation affordable. I do not yet accept that paid staffing should take priority over low fees.

item.title: Prioritise dependable opening hours
item.body: My priority is predictable access supported by reliable staffing. I do not yet accept that very low fees can sustain it.

item.title: Consider a limited trial before a long-term commitment
item.body: One possible approach is a bounded trial comparing fee and staffing arrangements. Neither party has agreed to run it.

requests.title: Which operating costs and usage assumptions still need evidence?
